description: Write clean Lua with locals discipline, 1-index awareness, and busted proof. Use for Lua, Neovim plugins, or game scripting.
idioms: local everything - globals only via _G explicitly
tables for modules, return them at file end
pcall for risky calls at boundaries
name: lua-code
pitfalls: zero-index habits - Lua arrays start at 1

sample.code:
local M = {}

function M.total(orders)
  local sum = 0
  for _, o in ipairs(orders) do
    sum = sum + o.cents
  end
  return sum
end

return M

style: local by default, UPPER for constants
short modules, one purpose per file
